howto.what: 提供科普主题、年代背景和核心科学结论后，Claude 会生成一整套视频素材：3分钟口播文案、30~35个分镜脚本、Veo2提示词清单和人物形象规范，保存到指定输出目录。
howto.when: 当你要制作历史科学类3分钟科普短视频、希望快速拿到完整素材包时使用。原文写明需要先给出主题、年代和核心科学结论作为输入。

say.text: 主题是蝴蝶效应的起源，年代1961年，核心结论是初始条件敏感依赖
say.note: 脚本调用大模型，约1~2分钟生成四份文件

say.text: 把复古风格参数改一下，重新生成一版素材

howto.what_en: After you give a topic, era, and core scientific conclusion, Claude generates a full material pack: a 3-minute voiceover script, 30-35 storyboard shots, Veo2 prompts, and character design, saved to your output folder.
howto.when_en: Use it when you need to make a 3-minute history-of-science explainer video and want a complete material pack quickly. The original requires topic, era, and core conclusion as input.

say_en.text: Theme: the butterfly effect's origin, 1961, conclusion: sensitive dependence
say_en.note: Script calls an LLM; four files in about 1-2 minutes
